headline: Xcel Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Infrastructure Investment Recovery
summary: Xcel Energy's Q2 earnings rose 24% and beat estimates as infrastructure recovery and lower power costs offset a revenue miss.

headline: NextEra Energy board declares quarterly dividend
summary: The board of directors of NextEra Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NEE) declared a regular quarterly common stock dividend of $0.6232 per share. The dividend is payable on Sept. 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on Aug. 28, 2026.

headline: DOE Is Converting Its Own Cold War Uranium Sites Into $100 Billion AI Data Centers
summary: The Department of Energy’s conversion of the 3,556-acre Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant into the $100 billion Paducah American Energy Hub signals the end of the era where AI infrastructure developers were forced to compete for scarce private land.
